authored.name: Blorb
authored.description: A small ball of caustic slime with legs slowly paces about.

authored.name: Glim
authored.description: A huge quadrupedal creature made of a green slime. Goo pours off its body in endless waves.

authored.name: Giant Rat
authored.description: A huge vermin, the size of a cat, with large yellow incisors.

authored.name: Cave Bat
authored.description: A small bat flits through the air.

authored.name: Shellback Beetle
authored.description: A huge, dog sized beetle with a hard, black shell prods its antenna at the ground.

authored.name: Needleling
authored.description: A dog sized creature with a large needle for a nose. It drips with a green liquid.

authored.name: Bear
authored.description: A bear walks along all fours, sniffing the ground for its next meal.

authored.name: Dire Bear
authored.description: A huge bear, of remarkable size. Each step shakes the ground.

authored.name: Tiger
authored.description: A prowling tiger, acutely aware of its target's vision, and how to stay out of it.

authored.name: Sabretooth Tiger
authored.description: A massive tiger with huge, sharp teeth growing from its mouth.

authored.name: Short-legged Saidribee
authored.description: A cat-sized bee hovers in the air, stinger prepared.

authored.name: Long-legged Saidribee
authored.description: A 5-foot bipedal creature. Its body is that of a dog sized bee, but with long, slender human-like legs.

authored.name: Saidribee Guardian
authored.description: A huge, quadrupedal bee-like creature, with large forelimbs that double as hands, and an intimidating stinger.

authored.name: Bombardier Beetle
authored.description: A huge lightning bug which has forsaken its wings for size. Its carapace emits a strange hum.

authored.name: Giant Beetle
authored.description: A giant beetle with buzzing wings hisses continuously.

authored.name: Unicorn
authored.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with one horn.

authored.name: Bicorn
authored.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with two horns.

authored.name: Tricorn
authored.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with three horns.

authored.name: Quadricorn
authored.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with four horns.

authored.name: Pentacorn
authored.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with five horns.

authored.name: Hexacorn
authored.description: A terrible, brutish bull-like creature with six horns.

authored.name: Heptacorn
authored.description: A famous magical horse-like creature with seven horns.

authored.name: Devil's Samara
authored.description: A large tree with razor-sharp, whirling seeds sprinkling down around it.

authored.name: River Drake
authored.description: A blue draconid, its scales quiver in anticipation of its next meal.

authored.name: Valta
authored.description: A deer made of moonlight shines in the darkness.

authored.name: Moonspawn
authored.description: A bear made of moonlight shines in the darkness.

authored.name: Killspawn
authored.description: A huge, lumbering ogre made of blades. Looking at it, you know it yearns for your death.

authored.name: Maulchild
authored.description: A large, child-like demon which seeks affection from all creatures.

authored.name: Hemogoblin
authored.description: A goblin made of blood.

authored.name: Hemogoblin Bloodmancer
authored.description: A goblin made of blood wearing a cloak, soaked through with his body-liquid.

authored.name: Hemogoblin Inventor
authored.description: A goblin made of blood carries a bag full of crystals and a map.

authored.name: Hemogoblin Mech
authored.description: A huge mechanical beast. The pinnacle of Hemogoblin warfare.

authored.name: Dryad
authored.description: An ordinarily peaceful creature, the flesh has twisted its mind into assisting it.

authored.name: Witch
authored.description: A whore who has forsaken her humanity for devilish power.

authored.name: Troll
authored.description: A huge, brutish biped. It clumsily drags its knuckles along the floor, tearing off skin which rapidly replaces itself.

authored.name: Kelpie
authored.description: An infamous man-eating water horse, known for dragging its victims to the bottom of the ocean with its kelp like tentacles.

authored.name: Wendigo
authored.description: A cannibalistic human who has long since given themselves to the madness of the flesh. It looks starved.

authored.name: Vampire
authored.description: A creature of decadence and excess, who, having grown tired of wine and sex, turned to blood and murder.

authored.name: Banshee
authored.description: The eternal spirit of those women who seek shelter in the flesh from their terrible suitors. Her shriek means death.

authored.name: Phoenix
authored.description: A creature of beautiful flame and rebirth, twisted by the flesh. Despite its corruption, its resurrection still comes quickly.

authored.name: Yeti
authored.description: An abominable snowman, which freezes all who dare to come close.

authored.name: Chimera
authored.description: An infamous firebreathing creature with the head of a lion, goat and serpent.

authored.name: Cancer
authored.description: A terrible crustacean, with claws of force enough to crush metal.

authored.name: Ursa Minor
authored.description: The legendary bear-child of Anavani. Her incestuous brother sleeps soundly, till she calls for aid with her dying breath.

authored.name: Ursa Major
authored.description: The elder bear-child of Anavani. His claws are unstoppable, and his maw means death.

authored.name: Minotaur
authored.description: A terrifyingly huge and stupid brute, with the head of a bull and the body of an ogre.

authored.name: Dragon
authored.description: The most famous of all flesh creatures, a terrifying beast of scale and flame.

authored.name: Sphinx
authored.description: The immortal Sphinx cares only for the chase, and stands guard eternal.

authored.name: Lesser Ichor-Fish

authored.name: Ichor Fish
authored.description: A golden fish born from Mercuria's well. It can act only in ichor; successful bites there restore 2% of its maximum health. This legacy creature retains the strength it had when it emerged.

authored.name: Bastidion
authored.description: A large, stationary fungus which emits clouds of toxic gas.

special.description: An ancient horror made of nothing. Spawned of the union of Grisha the Ever-Hungry and Dawel the End-Bringer, this creature is most easily seen through its lack of light, and most easily heard through its lack of sound.
